faqs.a:
(a)
The scope of this article shall include all streets hereafter constructed within the
               city, except extension in length of, or redevelopment of, existing streets in the
               areas that are substantially developed, or where unusual circumstances are present
               which would necessitate a different cross section in the opinion of the city engineer.
(b)
In addition, this article shall include all existing streets hereafter upgraded, widened
               or redesignated. The requirements herein enumerated shall be considered as a minimum;
               however, in instances where sound engineering practices would dictate, due to unusual
               or difficult topography, additional right-of-way and dedication thereof may be required.
               In addition, in the interest of preserving or protecting existing environmental conditions,
               or in the interest of protecting existing or future land uses from undesirable effects
               of such streets (including noise), the city may require the developer to dedicate
               additional rights-of-way and provide additional design considerations to provide for
               such circumstances. This article shall not preclude the adoption of a different cross
               section for any street that is substantially developed and for which the design standards
               contained in this article would not be appropriate.
(c)
Developers shall have the responsibility to dedicate necessary right-of-way and to
               construct street, curb, gutter and sidewalks to the standards adopted by the city,
               subject to the conditions and limitations specified in the Land Development Code and
chapter 74
.
(Code 1981, § 30-46; Ord. No. 1432, § 1, 3-6-1978; Ord. No. 2837, § 13, 8-5-1991;
               Ord. No. 3018, § 1, 11-15-1993)
